info.text:
Nvidia took in $1.27 billion a day last quarter (our math: $115.8B over 91 days).
Revenue hit $115.8 billion for the quarter ended Oct 25, up 103% from $57.0B a year ago (Nvidia, Nov 17).
Profit rose to $65.3 billion from $31.9 billion. Nvidia's own forecast for next quarter: $130 billion, plus or minus 3%.
Nvidia is about 6% of the S&P 500, so about $6 of every $100 in an S&P 500 fund rides on it.
Sources: Nvidia Q3 FY2027 release and CFO commentary (SEC 8-K, Nov 17), CNBC, Carson Group via Yahoo Finance.
News and education, not financial advice.
